title: CLO 2025.0 - Scope Dragging
description: Starting from version 2025.0, when clicking and dragging clothing in simulation mode, it supports defining the area and intensity of the drag, allowing for precise adjustments based on needs. This enables you to achieve more realistic folds and shapes of the clothing.

summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.0 - Scope Dragging ## Introduction This video introduces the range pull function for you. Starting from the 2025 version, when you press and pull the clothing in the simulation mode, the area and strength of the support for pull are defined, and the exact adjustment is made according to your needs. ## Application Scenarios Now, it shows several application scenarios for range pull: - **Single-Layer Clothing**: We can make small-range twist details through the range pull function. - **Suit Back Adjustment**: You can also make relatively large-range suit back adjustments. - **Multi-Layer Structure**: When you modify the posture, you can use the range pull to adjust the waist with a multi-layer structure. ## How to Use the Range Pull Next, let's take a look at how to use it: 1. **Open Simulation**: To use the range pull, we need to open the simulation first. 2. **Select Move Tool**: Once the simulation is opened, select the move tool to switch to the small-handle point pull tool. 3. **Activate Point Pull Tool**: At this time, press the point pull tool for two seconds, and you will see the tool group. 4. **Select Range Pull Tool**: Press the range pull tool and move the mouse to the 3D window of the clothing. You will see that, on the basis of the original grip, two new circles have been added. This is our range brush, which helps you understand the range of the influence of the range pull. ## Range Pull Window Settings In addition, we can also see that there is a range pull window setting, which is divided into two main contents: range and options. ### Range Settings - **Reduction Type**: The reduction type below the range is controlled by the shape of the pull effect. You can switch it to a curve or a straight line. - **Soft Selection Range**: The range of soft selection and the degree of reduction separately control the range of influence when the pull is applied and the range of the center point. - The smaller inner circle indicates the area where the pull effect is most directly applied. - As the effect radiates outward, the strength gradually decreases, resulting in a smooth natural reduction. ### Default Values - Soft Selection Range: Default value is 200, adjustable within the range of 1 to 500. - Degree of Reduction: Default value is 0, adjustable within the range of 2 to 2. ### Visual Feedback The chart area below can help you understand more objectively. When the reduction type is a curve, the pull selection area is not a single pull but a smoother, rounder, and wider shape. ## Example Adjustments Next, let's use the curve as an example to see the effect: 1. **Default Value**: Let's use the default value of the pull sleeve first and change the soft selection range to 250. Turn to the back of the suit to pull. You will see that the pull effect is more effective in the area where the same core is defined. 2. **Increase Soft Selection Range**: Set the soft selection range to 500 and pull the clothing. Compared to before, the area covered by the inner circle and the outer circle is now twice as wide, allowing you to pull a larger area. 3. **Minimum Soft Selection**: Now, set the value to the smallest and pull the panel again. The soft selection range is only 1 mm, allowing for a very small range of pull. 4. **Overlap Adjustment**: Change the soft selection range to 200 and set the reduction degree to the smallest value of 2. When you pull, the inner circle almost overlaps with the outer circle, distributing the pull effect evenly in a larger area. 5. **Maximum Concentration**: Finally, set the maximum value to 2 and pull the clothes again. The chart below will show that the pull force is highly concentrated at a specific point, indicating accurate operation in small areas. ## Reduction Type Options Next, we will adjust the reduction degree to 1. The reduction type is modified to a straight line, allowing you to define a smaller and more detailed core area to be squeezed. After switching to the straight line option, you will notice that the picture becomes sharper. When you pull the clothes, the selection range of the core area is narrower and more accurate than the curve line, allowing for better control of the pull. ## Pull Selection Area Control Next, let's take a look at how to display and control the pull selection area. At the bottom of the option, the range measurement method defines how to calculate the selection area from the actual point. It is divided into two types: surface and straight line. ### Surface Mode In the surface mode, the pull effect is only applicable to the surface of a selected layer within the specified range. Even if there are multiple layers, the same rule applies. However, when the pull and the strip are sewn together, any soft selection range defined will affect the area within the reduction range simultaneously. ### Straight Line Option The straight line option allows you to pull all the sheets within a certain distance, regardless of whether the selected sheet is sewn together with the sheets of other layers. When you use this option to pull the sheet, you will see that all the sheets within the defined range are affected at the same time. ### Range Brush Display The range brush display can help you understand the range of the pull function more objectively. You can also turn off the range brush display here. ## Use of Range Measurement Methods Now, let's take a look at the use of each range measurement method. The range brush display is only effective for the area being pulled when selecting the selected sheet. Whether it is the surface or the straight line as a range measurement method, it will only affect the currently selected sheet. When you want to pull a specific sheet in the given work process, regardless of which range measurement method you choose, this option is very useful. ## Full Weight Function Next, when the full weight function is used, the range brush display will show the pull area in green. If you turn off this option, the range brush display will no longer show the area in green, but it will not affect the effect of the range brush. ## Conclusion The range brush is not only used to adjust the overall effect of the clothes, but it can also help to quickly adjust various details such as knotting. First, reposition the fixed needle and prepare for the knotting. Then, select the range brush tool and adjust the range and the degree of reduction according to the area size of the brush. After the setting is complete, turn to the appropriate angle, pull the clothes to complete the knotting details. After achieving the desired effect, delete the fixed needle and continue to simulate. Thus, the introduction of the range brush function concludes here. I hope this function can help you quickly adjust the ideal clothing effect. ```
